name: Brown's Provin Mt Farm
tagline: Browns Provin Mt. Farm In Feeding Hills MA
description: A family-run berry farm in Feeding Hills, MA, Brown's Provin Mt Farm grows Strawberries. The farm is busiest in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
